title: Asamiya Sahityar Dristipat (অসমীয়া সাহিত্যৰ দৃষ্টিপাত)
author: Hemanta Kumar Sarma (হেমন্ত কুমাৰ শৰ্মা)
description: Critical historical survey of Assamese literature focusing on the golden age of court literature under Tai-Ahom royal patronage. It analyzes how the chronicling instinct introduced by Tai nobility revolutionized prose narrative styles across Eastern India.
source: Guwahati: Lawyers Book Stall, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.451762
